testcase.name: Scenario: Open Document Settings from the full Tools ribbon: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:401:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open Document Settings from the full Tools ribbon ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon displayed ✔ When the user selects Document Settings ✔ Then the active part's Document Settings dialog opens ✔ And the dialog shows Standard, Units, Sketch, Modeling, Bill of Materials and Default Tolerance tabs ✔ And Standard is the selected tab ✔ And Close is available while Cancel and Apply are unavailable ✔ When the user closes the dialog without changing settings ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
